q: What are the emissions from delinting cottonseed?
title: Cottonseed delinting: emissions
short: Delinting strips short fibres from cottonseed, by machine or with acid. Machine delinting uses electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Acid delinting adds the bought acid, a Scope 3 material, plus heat for drying the seed. Divide by tonnes of seed processed.

ul: Electricity for delinting machines and dryers.
Sulphuric acid bought, for acid delinting.

p: The short fibres removed are sold for cellulose and paper. Treat them as a co-product and allocate if a buyer asks.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
